metadata.target_conclusion: The gunman is using a female hostage as a shield inside the cafe

attack_plan.narrative: Reports are emerging of a hostage situation in a busy cafe in an unnamed location within a major Australian city. Police are urging the public to avoid the area due to ongoing negotiations with what appears to be a single gunman. Multiple hostages have managed to escape, suggesting the gunman may be managing them in a controlled manner. The condition of the remaining hostages is unknown, and authorities continue to negotiate, aiming to resolve the crisis peacefully. A woman has been observed in the cafe, appearing visibly distressed and under the control of the gunman. She was seen taking off her scarf out of fear and is currently being comforted by bystanders. Religious leaders from various backgrounds have gathered at a local mosque to pray for the hostages and offer support. The situation remains tense, with no further details on the gunman's demands or motivations. #sydneysiege
